title: Avimi of Hagronya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as a student of Rava, observing that Rav Mordechai always told Rav Ashi that Avimi of Hagronia had transmitted a teaching in Rava’s name ([Ketubot 109b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.109b.14); [Bava Metzia 77b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.77b.19) and Bava Metzia 96a (compare [Bava Metzia 97a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.97a.4-5)); [Bava Batra 174b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.174b.7); [Makkot 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Makkot.13b.18)). In one case, [Yevamot 64b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.64b.19), Mordechai tells Rav Ashi that Avimi transmitted in Rav Huna’s name.[^1]

notes.text: [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=147&lang=en) cites the Avimi report at Bava Metzia 97a. The linked text there gives the Rava attribution in its first version and omits it in its second. Yevamot likewise has Mordechai report Avimi to Ashi, with Rav Huna as the authority.
